run_scripts.gen.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# usage: gen.sh NAME ENV... -- GEN_ARGS...   (runs under the heavy wrapper; log in NAME.log)
R=/data/illia/nearproof-deps/w10-runs
BIN=${BIN:-$R/bin/oracle}
name=$1; shift
envs=()
while [ "$1" != "--" ]; do envs+=("$1"); shift; done
shift
cd $R
start=$(date +%s)
env NEAR_SUCCESSOR_OBSERVABLES=1 "${envs[@]}" HEAVY_MEM=12G /data/illia/nearproof-deps/bin/heavy \
  $BIN gen --domain d3 "$@" --out $R/runs/$name > $R/logs/$name.log 2>&1
echo "rc=$? seconds=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))" >> $R/logs/$name.log

#!/bin/bash
R=/data/illia/nearproof-deps/w10-runs
WT=/data/illia/nearproof/.claude/worktrees/agent-ad54daf2830fc99ec
mkdir -p $R/runs $R/logs $R/bin

cp $WT/tools/d3/mldsa65_bound.py $R/bin/mldsa65_bound.py

  gp=0; [ $((i%2)) -eq 0 ] && gp=100000000

  bash $R/gen.sh cy$s NEAR_SUCCESSOR_SCENARIO=curve-callbacks NEAR_XFAM_VARIANT=curve-yield-timeout NEAR_XFAM_MUTATE_EVERY=3 -- \
    --seed $s --first-chain $c --chains 1 --blocks 280 --mutate-every 0 --code-mutant-p 0 --ood-cap 100000 --drop-cap 12 --min-gas-price $gp &
  i=$((i+1))
done
for s in 1618 2718 31415 6151; do
  gp=0; [ $s -eq 2718 -o $s -eq 31415 ] && gp=100000000
  bash $R/gen.sh mb$s NEAR_SUCCESSOR_SCENARIO=mldsa NEAR_MLDSA_BOUND_SIGNER=$R/bin/mldsa65_bound.py -- \
    --seed $s --chains 1 --blocks 300 --mutate-every 0 --code-mutant-p 0 --ood-cap 2000 --min-gas-price $gp &
done
wait

run_scripts.replay.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# usage: replay.sh RUN [CHECKER_NAME] [EXTRA_LIST]   — replays col/RUN/{honest,mutants}.txt (or EXTRA_LIST)
R=/data/illia/nearproof-deps/w10-runs
WT=/data/illia/nearproof/.claude/worktrees/agent-ad54daf2830fc99ec
run=$1; chk=${2:-checker}; list=${3:-}
mkdir -p $R/rep
if [ -z "$list" ]; then
  cat $R/col/$run/honest.txt $R/col/$run/mutants.txt > $R/col/$run/all.txt
  list=$R/col/$run/all.txt
fi
HEAVY_MEM=24G /data/illia/nearproof-deps/bin/heavy python3 $WT/tools/d3/replay_successor.py --binary $R/bin/$chk --tier allFeatures \
  --cases-file $list --out $R/rep/$run-$chk --jobs 2 --timeout 3600 > $R/logs/rep-$run-$chk.log 2>&1
echo "rc=$?" >> $R/logs/rep-$run-$chk.log
run_scripts.blind.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Blind replay (--blind) of honest chunks of each family; 2 jobs, one family at a time.
WT=/data/illia/nearproof/.claude/worktrees/agent-ad54daf2830fc99ec
R=/data/illia/nearproof-deps/w10-runs
mkdir -p $R/blind
cat $R/col/se70*/honest.txt > $R/blind/se-honest.txt
cat $R/col/gdb81*/honest.txt > $R/blind/gd-honest.txt
grep -hv /mutants/ $R/col/mb*/bound.txt > $R/blind/mb-honest.txt
cat $R/col/cy60*/ctl-all.txt > $R/blind/cy-honest.txt
for f in se gd mb cy; do
  HEAVY_MEM=24G /data/illia/nearproof-deps/bin/heavy python3 $WT/tools/mainnet-replay/blind_corpus.py --binary $R/bin/checker \
    --cases $R/blind/$f-honest.txt --root / --out $R/blind/$f --jobs 2 --timeout 3600 > $R/logs/blind-$f.log 2>&1
  echo "blind $f rc=$?" >> $R/logs/queue.out
done
run_scripts.ctl.py:
"""Apply / revert one deliberate-breakage control in the Lean tree (item 10).
usage: ctl.py apply|revert NAME"""
import sys
L = '/data/illia/nearproof/.claude/worktrees/agent-ad54daf2830fc99ec/spec/lean/v3/NearSpecV3/'
CTL = {
    # ML-DSA-65: the z norm bound admits ‖z‖∞ = γ1 − β
    'mldsa-norm': [('MlDsa65.lean',
        '  z.all fun p => p.all fun c => c.natAbs < gamma1 - beta',
        '  z.all fun p => p.all fun c => c.natAbs ≤ gamma1 - beta')],
    # state init: one extra yocto credited when more actions follow the init in the receipt
    'stateinit-then': [('Successor/GlobalExecution.lean',
        '  let amount ← LM.okL (add128 acct.amount needed) (panicked "IntegerOverflowError")',
        '  let amount ← LM.okL (add128 acct.amount (needed + (if c.idx + 1 < c.nActs then 1 else 0))) (panicked "IntegerOverflowError")')],
    # yield timeout: the callback's promise result is Successful([]) instead of Failed
    'yield-timeout-result': [('Successor/StorageExecution.lean',
        'let rs ← forwardOrBufferR env rs ⟨acct, acct, rid, .data true d none⟩',
        'let rs ← forwardOrBufferR env rs ⟨acct, acct, rid, .data true d (some [])⟩')],
    # incoming receipt proofs: not verified for a proof that carries a distribution receipt
    'dist-proof': [('Successor/RuntimeCore.lean',
        'check (verifyReceiptProofD2 ci.prevOutgoingReceiptsRoot e) "invalid: receipt proof merkle path"',
        'check (verifyReceiptProofD2 ci.prevOutgoingReceiptsRoot e || e.receipts.any (fun r => match r.body with | .distribution _ => true | _ => false)) "invalid: receipt proof merkle path"'),
        # the legacy-core equalities (`rfl` against ChunkValidationD2) are exactly what this control
        # breaks, so the control build drops them (never committed)
        ('Successor/RuntimeCore.lean',
         'theorem legacy_core_eq (h : ActionHooks) (a : Bool) (c w : Bytes) (cap : Option Nat) :\n    checkD2CoreWith legacyDriver h a c w cap = checkD2Core h a c w cap := rfl\n',
         '-- ctl: legacy_core_eq dropped\n'),
        ('Successor/RuntimeCore.lean',
         'theorem legacy_genesis_eq (h : ActionHooks) (a : Bool) (c w : Bytes) (cap : Option Nat) :\n    checkD2CoreGWith legacyDriver h a c w cap = checkD2CoreG h a c w cap := rfl\n',
         '-- ctl: legacy_genesis_eq dropped\n'),
        # the resharding-capable core (used by the widest tiers) has its own copy of the check
        ('Successor/ReshardCore.lean',
         'check (verifyReceiptProofD2 ci.prevOutgoingReceiptsRoot e) "invalid: receipt proof merkle path"',
         'check (verifyReceiptProofD2 ci.prevOutgoingReceiptsRoot e || e.receipts.any (fun r => match r.body with | .distribution _ => true | _ => false)) "invalid: receipt proof merkle path"')],
}
# receipt proofs and the applied-receipts hash both skipped when a distribution receipt is present
_h = [(f, 'check (sha256 (encodeRcpts receipts) == w.appliedReceiptsHash) "invalid: applied receipts hash"',
       'check (sha256 (encodeRcpts receipts) == w.appliedReceiptsHash || receipts.any (fun r => match r.body with | .distribution _ => true | _ => false)) "invalid: applied receipts hash"')
      for f in ('Successor/RuntimeCore.lean', 'Successor/ReshardCore.lean')]
CTL['dist-proof-hash'] = CTL['dist-proof'] + _h
mode, name = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
for f, a, b in CTL[name]:
    p = L + f
    s = open(p).read()
    src, dst = (a, b) if mode == 'apply' else (b, a)
    n = s.count(src)
    assert n >= 1, (f, mode, name)
    s = s.replace(src, dst)
    open(p, 'w').write(s)
    print(mode, name, f, n)
